title: Fleet seat restore manifest
description: Machine-actionable fleet restore spec. INSTANCES carry hostnames and live in the owner's taskset (never this repo). Comment keys (_*) are permitted anywhere.

controller_ext_addr.description: the fleet-reachable controller address (what seats/mailboxes dial and the startup sentence carries); hub-local form is DERIVED as tcp://localhost:<same port>

venv.description: absolute venv path; hub-box workers inherit it when their own venv is absent

worker.description: A worker ALWAYS registers with its OWNING seat's controller — ownership is placement. `host`: 'localhost' = the hub machine, else an ssh alias. STAGING DISJOINTNESS LAW (owner jul29): a worker NEVER shares a staging with a coordinator session on the same box. Render/windowed/DRM needs are declared by specific tests/gates, never fleet data (owner jul29) — offscreen always works.

host.description: machine the worker runs on: 'localhost' (hub box) or an ssh alias

venv.description: absolute venv path used in the worker launch line; seat workers inherit the owning seat's env.venv when absent

repo.description: project checkout for the worker's obt env (--project); absent = the box's default association

host.description: 'localhost' = the hub machine (no ssh; SAME-BOX seats additionally require the obt config-isolation override + a non-default controller port), else the seat's ssh alias. Timeouts/boot-retry are tool defaults.

staging.description: the SEAT SESSION's staging — disjoint from every worker staging on the box (law, jul29)

config_dir.description: sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for the seat's claude session. ABSENT = variable explicitly UNSET (env -u) -> the box's default profile ~/.claude and its existing login (the hub-account inherit). Present = that profile dir (separate account; logs in once per box).

seat.description: Mailbox is DERIVED, never declared: coord-<name>, restrict msg,sync, joins hub advertise_addr, started by the seat session's own bringup. Restore ALWAYS verifies (roster presence + round-trip) — verification is not configurable.

hw.description: Hardware capability FACTS - never scheduling directives (owner jul29: capabilities do not always translate to job assignments; gate/job placement stays brief/ruling territory). Lives box-level on hub/seats; a WORKER carries its own hw only when its host differs from its owner's box or its access differs from the box (e.g. env lacking the display session).
